entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I have a VeloBand. The GPS tracker one. And, well, it's just not working. I'm so confused by all of this.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

I think it's broken. The pulse rate is completely wrong, and now it won't sync with my phone at all. It just seems defective. I'm not very good with technology, and I just feel overwhelmed. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I'm here to help. It's frustrating when a new device isn't doing what it's supposed to. Let me just pull up your order information and review our policy. Can I get the email address you used for the purchase?
Thank you, Sam. One moment... Okay, I see your order here. You received the VeloBand about 25 days ago. Let me check the return eligibility.
Alright, I've checked our knowledge base, and it looks like you are well within our 90-day return window.
Oh! Ninety days? Really? So... I can send it back then? I was so worried I was stuck with a broken thing.
Yes, absolutely. Since it's defective and you're within that 90-day period, I can process a full return for you right now. I'll send a prepaid shipping label to your email on file.
Wow, that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Charlie. You've made this so much easier than I thought it would be.
You're very welcome, Sam. I'm happy I could get this sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great rest of your day, and please look out for that email with the return instructions.
